topic: The IRS filing window most new residents miss

frames.headline: You have 91 days to file. Most people find out on day 80.

frames.label: The window opens
frames.body: Filing before this date is not possible, even if your paperwork is ready.

frames.label: The window closes
frames.body: It closes on the 30th whether or not that is a working day. There is no grace period.

frames.label: Cheapest late penalty
frames.body: That is the floor if you file voluntarily. It climbs sharply once they contact you first.

frames.headline: Put 30 June in your calendar now.
frames.action: Check your NIF details on Portal das Finanças before April.
